_what: One table of composed-candidate cards and what each one's placement is, read by the composer (`compose.placement_standing`, which `compose.rank_key` ranks on) and by the workbench (`candidateStanding.js::standingOf`, which the Candidate Set's strip and Next read). `refused` is null on a card for three different reasons and only one of them is a pass, and the two readers are in two languages, so neither can import the other; this file is what keeps them one reading. A case is a card as the server serves it, trimmed to the fields either reader looks at. The stop_reason string is `revise.STOP_PLACEMENT_UNJUDGED` and a test in each language holds its own copy to it.
_not_here: A `refused` body the APP cannot read (an unknown `kind`, a string) is the app's own fourth case and is tested in the app alone: the server is the writer of every kind it mints, so it has no way to have that case.
